a.lede: The remote access giant also urged its self-hosted customers to take down their own servers amid a "critical security incident," fearing the possibility of cyberattacks.
a.title: N-able takes its remote access service offline after researcher publishes dozens of zero-day bugs

b.lede: N-able released hotfixes to address zero-day bugs affecting its N-central remote monitoring and management (RMM) platform, which were publicly disclosed over the weekend and forced it to take vulnerable hosted environments offline. [...]
b.title: N-able releases security hotfixes for zero-day vulnerabilities
